messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the Q2 roadmap slate for the Dedicated pilot. Sales brought two firm asks: stricter tenant SLOs for latency, and tenant-level version pinning for A/B experiments. Need a short PRD (acceptance criteria + edge cases), rollout/experiment design, and rollback guardrails. Who can own what?

michael (Eng): I can own the PRD for runtime constraints. Quick clarifying Qs: which latency percentile do we guarantee (p95/p99)? and what's expected steady-state rps per tenant for the pilot?

sam (CS): HealthCo wants 99.9% p95 < 200ms for 512-token requests. They're okay with Dedicated if we support tenant pinning + audit logs. They also asked about pin expiration.

raj (SRE): Ops notes: Dedicated pools + canary routing need an automated fallback to a compatible hosted variant. Propose rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 1% over 5m OR latency p95 > 2x baseline for 3m. Also require auto-pin-expiry and an org-level kill-switch.

tess (Design): From UX: console needs a clear tenant pin UI: pin toggle, model selector, experiment label, and start/end times. Acceptance criteria should include visibility of active pins, expiration warnings, and an explicit renew flow.

michael (Eng): Draft experiment matrix proposal:
```
- Variant A: default model (open-7b)
- Variant B: quantized-8bit optimized model (open-7b-q8)
- Pinning granularity: tenant-level toggle
- Traffic ramps: 5/95 -> 20/80 -> 50/50
- Success metrics: latency p50/p95, error rate, quality eval (prompt set pass rate)
- Rollback triggers: see raj above
```

Anya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (sketch):
- PRD lists explicit SLOs per tier, experiment matrix, and rollout schedule.
- Perf tests: benchmark with 512-token traces, repeated 3 runs, baseline vs variant.
- Safety: ops runbook with rollback steps, alerting thresholds, and a canary checklist.
- UX: console flow for pinning + audit log entries visible to customer.
- Edge cases: partial KV cache loss, model seq-len mismatch fallback, pinned tenant running out of quota.

raj (SRE): Additions: pins should expire by default after 7 days unless renewed. For safety, any tenant pin that causes >50% latency regression for the pool should immediately be quarantined and traffic shifted away. Also require a global emergency kill switch that removes all pins.

sam (CS): I'll draft a short customer SLA addendum for the pilot (performance commitments + opt-out process). Legal will review but I can get a strawman ready.

michael (Eng): I'll produce the PRD draft by EOD tomorrow and include a config example for the pin API:
```
pin:
  tenant: "tenant-123"
  model: "open-7b-q8"
  expires_at: "2024-06-30T23:59:59Z"
  rollout: [5,20,50]
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: dedicated-pool-canary v2 -> staging at 1923456800 :rocket:

Anya (PM): Nice. Owners: michael -> PRD & rollout plan, raj -> ops runbook & alerting, tess -> UX flows + console copy, sam -> customer SLA. Next sync in ~15m (1923456880) to review the PRD strawman. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
